title: {Syn} Strassen Broke the Cubic Matrix Habit
content:
The standard matrix multiplication algorithm uses O(n^3) scalar multiplications. In 1969, Volker Strassen showed that matrices can be multiplied asymptotically faster.

Strassen method was shocking because it proved the textbook cubic algorithm was not the final word. Later work pushed the exponent even lower in theory.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
